headline: Palantir Q3 U.S. Commercial Revenue Exceeds Government Segment
summary: Palantir reported third-quarter earnings showing that its U.S. commercial business generated more revenue than its U.S. government segment, marking a key turning point.
why: Palantir Technologies is a major software company specializing in big data analytics, serving both commercial enterprises and defense agencies.

impacts.name: Palantir Technologies
impacts.why: Strong commercial segment revenue growth surpassing government revenue signals business expansion.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: The milestone of commercial revenue outpacing government revenue indicates successful diversification into the broader enterprise market, altering growth expectations for the company.
